parsed.explanation: The quoted Δ-system fact is false as stated: the chain {1},{1,2},{1,2,3},... has no infinite subfamily with constant pairwise intersection, and the sketched induction (delete a repeated element, 'continue') only terminates under a cardinality bound. Moreover Lemma 1's main claim is itself false (ledger: F_k={x_1..x_k,y_k} is intersecting with infinitely many minimal finite transversals), so the load-bearing 'In particular' clause, which the text derives from that main claim, is unsupported at the only place it is argued. The finiteness of C, hence L6.2, therefore rests on a false lemma as written. A one-sentence insertion (restrict to the subfamily of constant size ≤ K, then run the same petal argument) repairs it.
